threat_event: Passcodes and account passwords in ticket notes are read or exported by an attacker or insider
threat_source: Attacker with a workforce account; insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notes visible to every STPP user in the region; about 2.1 million tickets with passcodes and 96,000 with account passwords; notes never purged
existing_controls: Passcode vault at 680 stores; MFA; SIEM bulk export alert
treatment_plan: Vault at all 1,120 stores; purge notes back to 2018; stop collecting account passwords; card and credential pattern blocking in notes

threat_event: A technician views or copies personal content from a customer device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No technical limit or session record at stores and in-store counters; USB allowed; 37 complaints in 2025-2026
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D2 bench workstations; devices in custody
regulatory_driver: N81-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)); Manufacturer A agreement (contract)
existing_controls: Background checks; access standard; CCTV; sanctions
treatment_plan: Session logging and USB block at all benches; device content access only through approved test apps; customer-visible repair mode where the device supports it

threat_event: Misuse at in-store counters cannot be traced to a person because bench logins are shared
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared bench login per in-store counter; screen lock disabled
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 8.2.1); Manufacturer A agreement (contract)
treatment_plan: Named accounts with badge tap and PIN; MFA at shift start

threat_event: Malware on an in-store counter bench reaches retail POS lanes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bench network reachable from the POS lane network at 112 retail stores
affected_asset_or_process: In-store counter benches; retail store networks
treatment_plan: Separate counter networks with no route to the CDE; joint test with Retail
owner: Device Repair CISO with the Electronics Retail CISO

threat_event: A compromised update of a bench tool runs malicious code on bench workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 40 tools self-update from vendor sites; local administrator rights; no integrity checks
treatment_plan: Tool review gate; group software channel with signature checks; allow-listing; remove administrator rights

threat_event: Infected customer devices infect bench workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer devices connect by USB and network for transfers; scans only at depots
treatment_plan: Scan before data transfer at all benches; isolate customer device network segment

threat_event: A trade-in device is resold with recoverable customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2019 standard on SP 800-88 Rev. 1; no verification sampling at 2 depots
treatment_plan: SP 800-88 Rev. 2 standard; verification sampling at every depot; certificates per Appendix C

threat_event: A recycling drop-off device leaves custody without sanitization
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No per-device record for about 640,000 drop-offs a year; recycler certificates are per lot
treatment_plan: Serial capture at drop-off; sanitize or destroy before pickup; serial-level certificates from the recycler

threat_event: Recovered customer data is kept or exposed after the case closes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 9,000 closed cases older than 30 days still on lab storage; enterprise download links do not expire
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D2 data recovery labs; delivery storage
treatment_plan: Delete 30 days after delivery; expire enterprise links; purge the backlog

threat_event: Card numbers from phone payments are written or typed outside the P2PE terminals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Depot cashiers sometimes write card numbers before keying; notes accepted card numbers until June 2026
existing_controls: Pattern blocking in notes since June 2026
treatment_plan: Phone payments only through a P2PE terminal with the caller on the line; purge historical notes; quarterly data discovery

threat_event: The online booking page's scripts are tampered with to capture deposit card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Script change alerts reviewed weekly
affected_asset_or_process: Booking page with hosted payment fields
treatment_plan: Real-time alerts to the SOC

threat_event: AI-assisted diagnostics wrongly flags liquid damage and voids a customer's coverage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy measurement by device model; technicians accept most flags
affected_asset_or_process: AI-002 diagnostics; warranty and plan decisions
treatment_plan: Photo evidence and technician sign-off for every flag; accuracy by device model; customer appeal path (P10)

threat_event: Marketing claims about AI diagnostics are not substantiated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Website says 'AI-verified diagnostics'; no test data
treatment_plan: Withdraw the claim until P10 measurements support a specific statement

threat_event: The TPA interface fails and 38% of repair volume stops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single interface; paper fallback untested at scale
treatment_plan: Batch fallback file; joint failover test with the TPA
owner: Device Repair vice president of partner programs

threat_event: Manufacturer A's program audit finds breaches of program security terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared depot logins on Manufacturer B's portal; 24-hour notice procedure not written
existing_controls: Background checks; named accounts on Manufacturer A's portal
treatment_plan: Named portal accounts; notice procedure in P08; signed access standard before the 2026-11 audit
owner: Device Repair vice president of partner programs

threat_event: An incident misses the 24-hour manufacturer, acquirer, or TPA notice term
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terms not in the group matrix with owners and clocks
regulatory_driver: Manufacturer A agreement (contract); TPA agreement (contract); N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 12.10.1); N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(3)-(6))
treatment_plan: Add terms and owners to the P08 matrix; include them in the tabletop

threat_event: A regional provider A outage stops intake and release, and the standby fails under full load
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standby tested read-only only
treatment_plan: Full intake and release test on the standby

threat_event: Ransomware halts stores and depots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 410 bench workstations on an unsupported operating system
existing_controls: EDR; gold images; immutable STPP backups
treatment_plan: Retire unsupported systems

threat_event: A device is released to someone who is not its owner
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Release by claim tag and name check
existing_controls: Claim tag; one-time code for online status
treatment_plan: One-time code at release for high-value devices

threat_event: Devices in custody are stolen from a store or depot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cages and CCTV; no weekly reconciliation
treatment_plan: Weekly custody reconciliation

threat_event: Customer data stays on bench workstations after data transfers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transfer caches never wiped at stores
treatment_plan: Automatic cache wipe at session end

threat_event: Control gaps at depots and labs go unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance not documented for depots and labs
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix for depots and labs

threat_event: In-store counter staff follow retail procedures that conflict with Device Repair rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplement v2024; no in-store counter annex
treatment_plan: Re-issue the supplement with an in-store counter annex

threat_event: Background check reports are disposed of improperly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reports kept in the HR SaaS; some printed copies at depots
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; printed copies shredded under POL-04

threat_event: A courier loses mail-in devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tamper-evident packaging and tracking
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; courier contract covers loss

threat_event: Enterprise customers' corporate data on devices in depot custody is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Most enterprise devices arrive encrypted; some arrive unlocked
treatment_plan: Intake check that devices are locked or encrypted; contract clause on customer pre-wipe

threat_event: Passcodes pasted into the group chatbot are kept in transcripts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot asks for the ticket number but customers paste passcodes; transcripts kept 2 years
treatment_plan: Pattern redaction before storage; 90-day transcript retention; vendor no-training terms

threat_event: Bench workstations miss patches
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23% of store bench workstations missed the 30-day target in Q2 2026
treatment_plan: Patch through the image pipeline weekly; scanner coverage for all benches

threat_event: Store staff commit refund or parts fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual control; monthly exception review
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: A hurricane closes the Florida depot and stores for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One of 5 depots and about 210 stores in Florida
existing_controls: Other depots absorb mail-in work; STPP in the cloud
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; seasonal readiness checklist
